title: over door hooks
text: over door hooks. I was surprised that I needed to "assemble" this hook set - but it was small and easy to do - there are screws that you can attach to the door - but I didn't want it to be permanent so I did not use the mollys and screws.  It is sturdy and easy to install - fits easily in the door jam - works great as hooks!
